summary: OccHealthInfluenzaEditAll is a user control for managing influenza immunization records in a GridView environment. It provides functionality to update immunization status and seasonal details, handle grid data operations, and manage JavaScript for client-side interactions.
purpose: To facilitate the management and updating of occupational health influenza immunization records.
business_rules: Hide buttons when enrollment ID is zero
calculations: Year calculations based on influenza admin date
conditions: Check if gridDataEdit row is dirty
system_behavior: Enable/disable fields based on enrollment state
exceptions: Cancel operation if UserSession is null
